patch.value: GH-792: fresh-clone health must not require ignored runtime and empty extension directories

pm init ignores search and locks, and extension storage may be absent until first install, yet default health reports all three as required. Align default health with reproducible clone state while preserving strict structural integrity and pending-merge diagnostics.

A normal clone produced from pm init passes directory health without recreating ignored caches; history and schema remain fail-closed structural requirements; strict directory policy remains available; health remediation never loops through pm init; fresh-clone SDK and CLI regressions cover the distinction
Make default health portable across real Git clones without weakening material integrity
Agents can use health as a required CI context-integrity gate
